threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it’s normal to wait for the bus in the rain without an umbrella. Everyone else has perfected the art of dodging puddles.
Caught a glimpse of a fox lounging on the roof of a bus stop on Coldharbour Lane last night—never seen one so relaxed in the city.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw the kebab shop owner arguing with the BVG driver over the latest strike—only here do you get street politics mixed with dinner plans.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how in Kreuzberg, it’s common to see a full-on BBQ party in the middle of a street? Feels like every block could be a festival.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re local if they can name at least three taco trucks along Mission Street and know which one has the best salsa.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a magician performing card tricks for passengers. The usual delays didn’t matter; everyone was captivated, laughing all the way.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think paella is a local dish. Here, it’s all about the escalivada and the pintxos at the corner bars. Totally different vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by how they still hold their map upside down at the corner of Aribau and Casanova, looking lost among the locals.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'Stokey' and think the Newington Green is just a bit of grass, not a whole scene.
Heard a guy on the 36 bus last night talking about how his ex was dating a DJ, but he kept insisting he would ‘never be that guy’—and then he pulled out a mixtape.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: You know you're in Neukölln when the smell of döner and the sound of a street musician colliding with a baby crying is your morning wake-up call.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find people casually playing ping pong in the middle of a park while the tram rumbles past. It's a vibe you can't replicate.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they handle BART delays—real ones know to bring a snack and a book, not just a phone.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy serenading the 38 Geary crowd with a ukulele. Only in SF, where even bus stops become mini-concerts.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think the true charm of Gràcia is just in the plazas, but it’s really the winding streets after dark where the real vibe unfolds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still marvel at the street performers in Plaça del Sol, oblivious to how quickly that sparkle fades.
